connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Vulnerabilities
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Vulnerabilities data connector ingests vulnerabilities FullHunt identified on your external assets. The connector takes a full snapshot once a day; each snapshot re-ingests every vulnerability, so query the latest record per IssueId from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. The data connector is built on the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework.

sampleQueries.description: Open FullHunt vulnerabilities from the latest snapshot
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntVulnerabilities_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IssueId
| where StatusName in ('New', 'Triaged')
| project Host, Title, Severity, StatusName, IdentifiedAt, LastSeen

FullHuntVulnerabilities_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IssueId
| where StatusName in ('New', 'Triaged')
| summarize Vulnerabilities = count() by Severity

dataTypes.name: FullHuntVulnerabilities_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FullHuntVulnerabilities_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FullHunt Enterprise API key
customs.description: A FullHunt Enterprise account and its API key are required. See the [FullHunt authentication documentation](https://docs.fullhunt.io/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect FullHunt Vulnerabilities to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Copy your API key from your [FullHunt profile settings](https://fullhunt.io/user/settings/), then enter it below and select **Connect**. The connector polls FullHunt once a day (full snapshot).
